papers.title: Attention-Guided Transformer Network for Polyp Segmentation in Colonoscopy Images
papers.abstract: Polyp segmentation is crucial for early colorectal cancer diagnosis. We propose a transformer-based network with a multi-scale attention decoder that captures both local and global contextual information. Experiments on three public datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with a Dice score of 0.923 on Kvasir-SEG and 0.891 on CVC-ClinicDB. Our approach shows particular strength in segmenting polyps with unclear boundaries. Code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/example/attention-polyp.
